verdict.rationale: Insomnia documents a Scratch Pad with "no login ever required" and lets projects use Local Vault storage. Git Sync can also store data in any third-party Git repo without going through the cloud. That covers local, account-free work, but the evidence never explicitly says full local-vault projects or organizations work offline without an account. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that Local Vault workspaces are fully usable without a cloud account or login, documented offline operation, and independent hands-on confirmation of account-free offline use.
